description: This Java source file defines a class MockHiveMqtt3ClientFactory that mocks an MQTT client connection for testing purposes using the HiveMQ client library and Mockito. It provides methods to simulate connection errors, message handling, and client behaviors for unit testing MQTT interactions.

classes.name: MockHiveMqtt3ClientFactory
classes.description: A mock implementation of HiveMqtt3ClientFactory for testing MQTT client interactions with HiveMQ.

methods.name: withException
methods.description: Configures the factory to simulate a connection exception during client connection.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Adds a single Mqtt3Publish message to the internal message store for a specific topic.

methods.name: withMessages
methods.description: Adds multiple messages to the internal message store.

methods.name: withTestProbe
methods.description: Sets the ActorRef testProbe for message verification.

methods.name: withFailingSubscribe
methods.description: Configures the subscribe future to simulate a failure during subscription.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that the disconnect method was called at least once on each client.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates a mocked MQTT client instance with specified behaviors and optional exception simulation.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Returns a mocked Mqtt3ClientBuilder with a predefined client.
